requirements.title: ENCDNS_IP* attribute format
requirements.statement: The ENCDNS_IP* Configuration Payload Attribute MUST have the format shown in Figure 1, with the fields in the order shown.

requirements.title: Reserved bit ignored on receipt
requirements.statement: The R bit MUST be ignored on receipt.

requirements.title: Reserved bit set to zero
requirements.statement: The R bit MUST be set to zero.

requirements.title: Length field size
requirements.statement: The Length field MUST be 2 octets.

requirements.title: Length field value
requirements.statement: The Length field MUST be the length of the enclosed data in octets.

requirements.title: Num Addresses zero in request-without-resolver and ACK
requirements.statement: The Num Addresses field MUST be 0 if the Configuration payload has type CFG_REQUEST and no specific DNS resolver is requested, or if it has type CFG_ACK.

requirements.title: Zero Length omits trailing fields
requirements.statement: If the Length field is set to 0, the subsequent fields shown in Figure 1 MUST NOT be present.

requirements.title: ENCDNS_IP4 length formula
requirements.statement: For ENCDNS_IP4 attributes in CFG_REQUEST, CFG_REPLY, or CFG_SET Configuration payloads, the length of the attribute MUST be 4 + Length of the ADN + N * 4 + Length of SvcParams, where N is the number of included IPv4 addresses.

requirements.title: ENCDNS_IP6 length formula
requirements.statement: For ENCDNS_IP6 attributes in CFG_REQUEST, CFG_REPLY, or CFG_SET Configuration payloads, the length of the attribute MUST be 4 + Length of the ADN + N * 16 + Length of SvcParams, where N is the number of included IPv6 addresses.

requirements.title: ADN length interpretation
requirements.statement: The 16-bit unsigned integer MUST be interpreted following the rules specified in Section 2.4.1 of RFC9460.

requirements.title: AliasMode zero prohibited
requirements.statement: This field MUST NOT be set to 0.

requirements.title: Reject zero value for CFG_REPLY and CFG_SET
requirements.statement: If the Configuration payload has type CFG_REPLY or CFG_SET, this value MUST NOT be set to 0.

requirements.title: Define ADN Length as a one-octet field
requirements.statement: The ADN Length field MUST be 1 octet and indicate the length of the Authentication Domain Name field in octets.

requirements.title: ENCDNS_IP4 field carries IPv4 addresses
requirements.statement: For ENCDNS_IP4, this field MUST contain one or more 4-octet IPv4 addresses.

requirements.title: ENCDNS_IP6 field carries IPv6 addresses
requirements.statement: For ENCDNS_IP6, this field MUST contain one or more 16-octet IPv6 addresses.

requirements.title: Authentication Domain Name format
requirements.statement: The Authentication Domain Name MUST be a fully qualified domain name of the encrypted DNS resolver, in DNS presentation format, and use an IDNA A-label.

requirements.title: Reject terminators in the name
requirements.statement: The name MUST NOT contain terminators such as NULL or CR.

requirements.title: Encode SvcParams using RFC9460 wire format
requirements.statement: SvcParams MUST be encoded using the wire format specified in Section 2.2 of RFC9460.

requirements.title: Exclude ipv4hint and ipv6hint SvcParams
requirements.statement: The service parameters MUST NOT include "ipv4hint" or "ipv6hint" SvcParams.

requirements.title: Apply service parameters to all IP addresses
requirements.statement: Service parameters MUST apply to all IP addresses in the ENCDNS_IP* Configuration Payload Attribute.

requirements.title: Encode ENCDNS_DIGEST_INFO fields in table order
requirements.statement: The ENCDNS_DIGEST_INFO Configuration Payload Attribute MUST contain the R bit, Attribute Type, Length, Num Hash Algs, ADN Length, Authentication Domain Name, List of Hash Algorithm Identifiers, and Certificate Digest fields in the order shown.

requirements.title: Encode ENCDNS_DIGEST_INFO CFG_REQUEST fields in table order
requirements.statement: The ENCDNS_DIGEST_INFO Configuration Payload Attribute in CFG_REQUEST MUST contain the R bit, Attribute Type, Length, Num Hash Algs, ADN Length, and List of Hash Algorithm Identifiers fields in the order shown.

requirements.title: Ignore the reserved bit on receipt
requirements.statement: Receivers MUST ignore the R bit on receipt.

requirements.title: Set the reserved bit to zero
requirements.statement: Senders MUST set the R bit to zero.

requirements.title: Set Attribute Type to 29
requirements.statement: The Attribute Type field MUST be set to 29.

requirements.title: Define Length as a two-octet unsigned integer
requirements.statement: The Length field MUST be a 2-octet unsigned integer indicating the length of the enclosed data in octets.

requirements.title: Set length from hash-algorithm count
requirements.statement: The Length field MUST be set to 2 + (2 * the number of included hash algorithm identifiers).

requirements.title: Num Hash Algs reflects identifier count
requirements.statement: The Num Hash Algs field MUST indicate the number of identifiers included in the List of Hash Algorithm Identifiers field.

requirements.title: Derive Num Hash Algs from Length
requirements.statement: The Num Hash Algs field MUST be set to (Length - 2) / 2.

requirements.title: Set ADN Length to zero
requirements.statement: The ADN Length field MUST be set to 0.

requirements.title: List supported hash algorithm identifiers
requirements.statement: The List of Hash Algorithm Identifiers field MUST contain 16-bit hash algorithm identifiers supported by the encrypted DNS client.

requirements.title: Limit identifiers to IANA registry values
requirements.statement: The values of the List of Hash Algorithm Identifiers field MUST be identifiers taken from IANA's IKEv2 Hash Algorithms registry.

requirements.title: Omit padding between identifiers
requirements.statement: There MUST be no padding between the hash algorithm identifiers.

requirements.title: Encode attribute layout as specified
requirements.statement: The ENCDNS_DIGEST_INFO Configuration Payload Attribute MUST use the field layout shown in the table: R, Attribute Type, Length, Num Hash Algs, ADN Length, Authentication Domain Name, Hash Algorithm Identifier, and Certificate Digest.

requirements.title: Ignore R bit on receipt
requirements.statement: The R bit MUST be ignored on receipt.

requirements.title: Set R bit to zero
requirements.statement: The R bit MUST be set to zero.

requirements.title: Set Attribute Type to 29
requirements.statement: The Attribute Type value MUST be 29.
notes: Tightened from the RFC wording so the invariant is explicit and testable.

requirements.title: Set Length to data size
requirements.statement: The Length field MUST be the length of the data in octets.
notes: Renumbered from a colliding hint to keep requirement IDs unique in this batch.

requirements.title: Set Num Hash Algs to 1
requirements.statement: The Num Hash Algs field MUST be set to 1.

requirements.title: ADN Length indicates Authentication Domain Name length
requirements.statement: The ADN Length field MUST indicate the length of the Authentication Domain Name field in octets.

requirements.title: ADN Length zero applies to conveyed Authentication Domain Name
requirements.statement: If the ADN Length field is set to 0, the digest MUST apply to the Authentication Domain Name conveyed in the ENCDNS_IP* Configuration Payload Attribute.

requirements.title: Authentication Domain Name is a fully qualified domain name
requirements.statement: The Authentication Domain Name MUST be a fully qualified domain name of the encrypted DNS resolver following the syntax defined in RFC 5890.

requirements.title: Prohibit terminators in name
requirements.statement: The name MUST NOT contain any terminators such as NULL or CR.
notes: Renumbered from a colliding hint to keep requirement IDs unique in this batch.

requirements.title: Name included only with multiple ADNs
requirements.statement: The name MUST be included only when multiple ADNs are included in the ENCDNS_IP* Configuration Payload Attribute.
notes: Renumbered from a colliding hint to keep requirement IDs unique in this batch.

requirements.title: Hash Algorithm Identifier selects digest algorithm
requirements.statement: The Hash Algorithm Identifier field MUST specify the 16-bit hash algorithm identifier selected by the DNS resolver to generate the digest of its certificate.

requirements.title: Certificate Digest includes SPKI hash
requirements.statement: The Certificate Digest field MUST include the Subject Public Key Info (SPKI) hash of the encrypted DNS resolver certificate using the algorithm identified in the Hash Algorithm Identifier field.

requirements.title: Certificate Digest length formula
requirements.statement: The Certificate Digest field length MUST equal Length - 4 - ADN Length.

requirements.title: ENCDNS_DIGEST_INFO allowed in CFG_ACK
requirements.statement: The ENCDNS_DIGEST_INFO attribute MAY be present in the Configuration payload of CFG_ACK.

requirements.title: Zero-length ENCDNS_DIGEST_INFO data in CFG_ACK
requirements.statement: When the ENCDNS_DIGEST_INFO attribute is present in the Configuration payload of CFG_ACK, it MUST be returned with zero-length data.
notes: Renumbered from a colliding hint to keep requirement IDs unique in this batch.

requirements.title: Handle malformed attributes per RFC7296
requirements.statement: Badly formatted attributes or unacceptable fields MUST be handled as specified in Section 2.21 of [RFC7296].

requirements.title: Advertise encrypted DNS support in CFG_REQUEST
requirements.statement: The initiator MUST indicate support for encrypted DNS by including ENCDNS_IP* attributes in its CFG_REQUEST payloads.

requirements.title: Provide encrypted DNS configuration in CFG_REPLY
requirements.statement: The responder MUST supply encrypted DNS configuration by including ENCDNS_IP* attributes in its CFG_REPLY payloads.

requirements.title: Include ENCDNS_IP4 or ENCDNS_IP6 in CFG_REQUEST
requirements.statement: If the initiator supports encrypted DNS, it MUST include either or both of the ENCDNS_IP4 and ENCDNS_IP6 attributes in its CFG_REQUEST.

requirements.title: Set Length to 0 when not requesting specific resolvers
requirements.statement: If the initiator does not want to request specific DNS resolvers, it MUST set the Length field to 0 for the attribute.

requirements.title: Allow empty attribute or distinct resolver list
requirements.statement: For a given attribute type, the initiator MAY send either an empty attribute or a list of distinct suggested resolvers.

requirements.title: Allow ENCDNS_DIGEST_INFO hash algorithm list
requirements.statement: The initiator MAY also include the ENCDNS_DIGEST_INFO attribute with a list of hash algorithms supported by the encrypted DNS client.

requirements.title: Ignore duplicate identical attributes after the first
requirements.statement: If the request includes multiple bitwise identical attributes, the responder SHOULD process only the first occurrence and ignore the rest.

requirements.title: Allow discarding requests with too many repeated attributes
requirements.statement: The responder MAY discard the full request if the count of repeated attributes exceeds an implementation-specific threshold.

requirements.title: Return ENCDNS_IP* attributes when supported and allowed
requirements.statement: For each ENCDNS_IP* attribute from the CFG_REQUEST, if the responder supports the corresponding address family and there are no policy restrictions, the responder MUST send back one or more ENCDNS_IP* attributes in the CFG_REPLY with an appropriate list of IP addresses, service parameters, and an ADN.

requirements.title: Require at least one IP address
requirements.statement: The list of IP addresses MUST include at least one IP address.

requirements.title: Prefer the alpn service parameter
requirements.statement: The service parameters SHOULD include at least the "alpn" service parameter.

requirements.title: Allow the responder to ignore suggested values
requirements.statement: The responder MAY ignore suggested values from the initiator, if any.

requirements.title: Return multiple ENCDNS_IP attributes when needed
requirements.statement: Multiple instances of the same ENCDNS_IP* attribute MAY be returned if distinct ADNs or service parameters need to be assigned to the initiator.

requirements.title: Present returned instances by service priority
requirements.statement: These instances MUST be presented to a local DNS client following their service priority, where a smaller service priority value indicates a higher preference.

requirements.title: Optionally return digest info
requirements.statement: The responder MAY return the ENCDNS_DIGEST_INFO attribute to convey a digest of the encrypted DNS certificate and the identifier of the hash algorithm used to generate the digest.

requirements.title: Use encrypted DNS resolvers when offered
requirements.statement: If the initiator receives both ENCDNS_IP* and INTERNAL_IP6_DNS (or INTERNAL_IP4_DNS) attributes, it SHOULD use the encrypted DNS resolvers.

requirements.title: Encrypted DNS session uses conveyed address
requirements.statement: The DNS client MUST establish an encrypted DNS session with the address or addresses conveyed in ENCDNS_IP*.

requirements.title: Resolver certificate authentication uses RFC8310 Section 8 mechanisms
requirements.statement: The DNS client MUST use the mechanisms discussed in Section 8 of RFC 8310 to authenticate the DNS resolver certificate using the ADN conveyed in ENCDNS_IP*.

requirements.title: Create an SPKI hash when digest info is present
requirements.statement: If the CFG_REPLY includes an ENCDNS_DIGEST_INFO attribute, the client MUST create an SPKI hash of the DNS resolver certificate received in the TLS handshake using the negotiated hash algorithm in the ENCDNS_DIGEST_INFO attribute.

requirements.title: Validate the resolver certificate when the digest matches
requirements.statement: If the computed digest for an ADN matches the digest sent in the ENCDNS_DIGEST_INFO attribute, the client MUST consider the encrypted DNS resolver certificate successfully validated.
notes: Normalized the declarative success condition into a testable validation outcome.

requirements.title: Treat resolver certificate validation failure as non-recoverable
requirements.statement: If resolver certificate validation fails, the client MUST treat the failure as a non-recoverable error.

requirements.title: Split-tunnel internal DNS resolution
requirements.statement: When the IPsec connection is a split-tunnel configuration and the initiator has negotiated INTERNAL_DNS_DOMAIN as specified in RFC 8598, the DNS client MUST resolve the internal names using the ENCDNS_IP* DNS resolvers.

requirements.title: INTERNAL_DNS_DOMAIN may accompany ENCDNS_IP* without DNS attribute precondition
requirements.statement: If ENCDNS_IP* attributes are supplied, responders MAY include INTERNAL_DNS_DOMAIN even when INTERNAL_IP6_DNS or INTERNAL_IP4_DNS attributes are absent.

requirements.title: Compute SPKI hash from DER-encoded SPKI
requirements.statement: The SPKI hash of the encrypted DNS resolver certificate MUST be the output of a cryptographic hash algorithm over the DER-encoded ASN.1 representation of the SPKI.
notes: Trimmed for canonical assembly without changing the required input or output relationship.

requirements.title: Support SHA2-256
requirements.statement: Implementations MUST support SHA2-256.

requirements.title: Disallow ENCDNS_IP* use after NULL authentication unless preconfigured
requirements.statement: If the IKEv2 responder has used the NULL Authentication method to authenticate itself, the initiator MUST NOT use returned ENCDNS_IP* resolvers configuration unless the initiator is preconfigured, e.g., in the operating system or the application.
